# SteerCo: Voltaro Ladetechnik GmbH

2026-10-26 · stage scale · health amber

## Where we are

Live. Of the agents in scope, 5 of 5 meet the bar to work on their own (Requirement extraction, Red-flag detection, Norms and standards, Configuration (CPQ), Technical documentation). Tenders lose most time in the queue for commercial review (1.2 days per tender). About 3,293 hours a year come back, 1,980 of them in sales engineering: the work of 2.2 people, worth 333,501 EUR against a fee of 72,000. Half of all bids go out within 2.9 days instead of 6.5 (between 3.4 and 3.8 days faster, 90 % of resamples).

## KPIs

| KPI | Target | Now | Basis |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Requirements found on scored tenders | 95% | 100% (green) | scored on 40 past tenders |
| Red flags found | 95% | 98% (green) | scored on 40 past tenders |
| Median days from request to bid | 4.0 days | 3.4 days (green) | measured since go-live |
| Sales engineering hours per submitted bid | 9.0 h | 7.5 h (green) | measured since go-live |
| Agent answers confirmed unchanged | 85% | n/a (unknown) | reviews in the workbench |

## Value

About 3,293 hours a year come back, 1,980 of them in sales engineering: the work of 2.2 people, worth 333,501 EUR against a fee of 72,000. Half of all bids go out within 2.9 days instead of 6.5 (between 3.4 and 3.8 days faster, 90 % of resamples).

## Decisions needed

- Configure and price: effort is 79% of what it was, the plan was 60%. Find out with the users why.
- Technical review: effort is 102% of what it was, the plan was 70%. Find out with the users why.

## Risks

- Engineering keeps reading every specification in full, so technical review time has not moved. Mitigation: Calibration session: engineering reviews 10 tenders from the red-flag list only and compares. (Jonas Reiter)
- Grid-connection norm VDE-AR-N 4110 missing from the capability profile: the agents ask on every tender. Mitigation: Confirm the certificate status with quality and update the profile. (Strategist)
